task_description: notify.messages.send must take a channel argument (default "email") and include it in the record it returns. Onboarding messages must go out by "sms"; billing keeps the default. Update the function and its callers.

args.patch:
--- a/notify/messages.py
+++ b/notify/messages.py
@@ -2,4 +2,4 @@
 
 
-def send(user: str, text: str) -> dict[str, str]:
-    return {"to": user, "text": text}
+def send(user: str, text: str, channel: str = "email") -> dict[str, str]:
+    return {"to": user, "text": text, "channel": channel}
--- a/notify/onboarding.py
+++ b/notify/onboarding.py
@@ -4,2 +4,2 @@
 def welcome(user: str) -> dict[str, str]:
-    return messages.send(user, f"Welcome aboard, {user}!")
+    return messages.send(user, f"Welcome aboard, {user}!", channel="sms")
